descriptionHtml:
20cm of egg-crate foam. Bolstered all round. Still a low way in.

Burnmoor is an XXL orthopaedic dog sofa bed, 132 × 104 × 20cm, with a profiled egg-crate foam core, four bolstered sides and a waterproof liner around the foam.

Three in the morning is when you hear it. A very heavy dog shifts, finds the edge with a shoulder, and half of them ends up on the boards.

At 132 × 104cm there is floor area spare when a dog of 50kg lies out flat. The egg-crate profile spreads that weight instead of packing down under it.

What they get

  • 132 × 104cm and 20cm deep: A true XXL footprint, with no part of them hanging off.
  • Bolsters on all four sides: Whichever way they roll, an edge is already there.
  • A lowered front section: The way in stays low for a heavy dog with stiff back legs.
  • A waterproof liner around the foam: The flannel cover lifts off. The liner keeps a wet night off the core.

Best for: giant breeds of 50kg and up, and houses where accidents have already started.

Why it is worth the money

£185, and this is where it goes. It takes 20cm of depth to carry 50kg or more without bottoming out, and 132 × 104cm before a giant breed stops hanging off the side. The liner is what stops one bad night ending the bed. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One thing before you order. It comes in one size and that size is enormous. A 132cm bed wants a wall to sit against, so measure the room first.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Suits
XXL, one size132 × 104 × 20Giant breeds of 50kg and over

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolsters take up some of that. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner with a damp cloth. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Will it fit my dog?

One size, 132 × 104 × 20cm outside. Send a breed and a weight for a straight answer.

How much is delivery?

Free over £40. Your postcode window shows beside the basket button.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

How low is the front?

Lower than the other three sides, so a heavy dog steps over rather than climbs. No step-in figure is published for it.

Will it suit an older dog?

We can say what the bed is, not what it will do. It is 20cm of egg-crate foam with a lowered front. The rest is a vet conversation.

Can I actually wash it?

The flannel cover comes off and washes to its sewn-in label. The liner wipes down.

What if they ignore it?

Back it goes inside the 100 nights. Free collection, full refund.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
